scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,bff,catalog,shell -c yellow,green,magenta,cyan "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/bff dev" "bun run --cwd apps/catalog dev" "bun run --cwd apps/shell dev"
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/bff test
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/catalog build && bun run --cwd apps/shell build
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n shell,catalog -c cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd apps/shell preview" "bun run --cwd apps/catalog preview"
